baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired conditionals "إن ضللت...على نفسي" and "وإن اهتديت فبما يوحي إلي ربي" assign opposite causal accounts to error and guidance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deviation leaves the intended path and lands on the speaker's own self, while guidance is credited to a hidden divine communication delivered under formative Lordship. Hearing and nearness keep that asymmetric account relational rather than fatalistic.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the negative path mechanism.
The self as the very identity of the thing localizes the loss in the speaker rather than exporting it.
Gentle indication toward path and truth supplies the positive reorientation.
Divine report and inspiration identify the credited source of reorientation.
Repair, nurture, and completion make Lordship the formative agency behind guidance.
Actual hearing makes the declaration answerable to an attentive addressee.
Nearness removes remoteness between the speaking subject and the source who hears.

changed_reading.before: If the speaker errs, he bears it; if he is guided, revelation causes it.
changed_reading.after: The verse is an asymmetric causal ledger: path-loss is charged to the speaker's own identity, while recovered direction is received from the nearby, hearing Lord who forms and completes him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast between "ضللت" and "بما يوحي إلي" joins loss or disappearance to a communication that arrives in concealment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The error side can be modeled as losing an object, location, or retained trace; the guidance side supplies a subtle signal that restores orientation. Hearing and nearness describe a short communication circuit even though the transmitted knowledge is hidden.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance and concealment recast error as becoming unavailable to orientation.
Loss of a thing or its location supplies the missing-position problem.
Loss of retention adds a memory or signal-failure mode to straying.
Guidance resolves the lost-position problem by indicating the route and truth.
Knowledge delivered secretly supplies the restoring signal without making it publicly self-generated.
A subtle voice gives the hidden delivery an acoustic edge.
Hearing supplies reception at the far end of the signal relation.
Nearness makes recovery a low-distance relation rather than a remote search.

changed_reading.before: Error is a wrong belief, whereas revelation supplies the right belief.
changed_reading.after: Error is also loss of position, visibility, or retention; revelation is the nearby hidden signal by which a lost subject is located and reoriented.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative "قل" turns a first-person account of receiving revelation into an overt utterance.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hidden communication is not retained as private interior knowledge: the commanded speaker voices it, names his own possible failure, and submits the result to the One who hears. The speaking self is therefore a conduit and accountable receiver, not the autonomous origin of the claim.

activation_trace.role: Bringing speech out by articulation turns the conditional into a public act.
The self's intention and discernment locate the internal point at which reception can fail or take hold.
Hidden impartation supplies what precedes and authorizes the overt speech.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception answerable in action, not only audible.

changed_reading.before: The speaker reports his private epistemic condition.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs a conversion from hidden reception to commanded public speech, with the speaker openly owning failure while refusing authorship of guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first supplies vertical delivery, then explicitly aligns what is sent down from the Lord with stable truth, guidance, and a straight road. This turns the focus verse's "بما يوحي" from a generic source claim into a transport sequence whose delivered content becomes traversable orientation.

activation_trace.role: Descent and arrival place downward delivery inside the surah's opening circulation pattern.
Caused descent and conveyance identify the content as something delivered to the addressee.
Truth as stable correspondence marks the delivered content as reality-bearing.
Gentle indication converts delivered truth into directional guidance.
The straight road gives the directional result a traversable form.
The focus revelation is the local receiving point of that delivered truth-route.

structural_cues: 34:2 sequences entering, exiting, descending, and ascending; 34:6 sequences what is sent down from the Lord, truth, guidance, and road.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, truth, guidance, and road in sequence; I supply the causal arrow from delivered content to verified orientation. A live alternative is that 34:6 coordinates attributes without specifying process stages.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is guided because his Lord reveals something to him.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is the terminal effect of a delivery chain: content descends, proves reality-bearing, and opens a road that the receiver can follow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated commands to say, followed by the focus's own "قل", make the first-person conditional one commissioned segment in a surah-wide speech chain. The exchange "What did your Lord say? ... the truth" further identifies utterance as a carrier of reality rather than self-originating opinion.

activation_trace.role: An opposing assertion and the answering command establish a recurring public speech contest.
The repeated acts of saying form a relay that asks after and reports the Lord's speech.
Stable correspondence with reality is the reported content at the end of the relay.
The command to articulate immediately precedes the focus and continues the commission.
A second adjacent command makes the focus's opening imperative part of a concentrated sequence.
The focus utterance is voiced under the same commission rather than initiated as autobiography.

structural_cues: The packet repeats "قل" across 34:3, 22, 24-27, 30, 36, 39, and 46-50, with three consecutive commands at 34:48-50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated imperatives and the Lord-speech/truth exchange; I infer that repetition subordinates the first-person voice to a commission. The alternative is to treat each imperative as only a local discourse marker.

changed_reading.before: The speaker independently qualifies his own possibility of error and guidance.
changed_reading.after: The speaker is instructed to voice his own fallibility; the very sentence that denies self-authorship of guidance is itself an enacted piece of received guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier formulations place people inside far error and contrast being upon guidance with being inside clear error. The focus shifts to "أضل على نفسي": error is no longer only an enclosing region but a consequence loaded onto the self, while the guidance clause marks its enabling source with "بما".

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance supplies the enclosing state named by the verse's "in" construction.
Distance from nearness stretches that error field away from access.
Path indication supports the construction of being upon a directional footing.
Straying again supplies the alternative containing field.
Manifestness makes the error field exposed rather than merely obscure.
The focus repeats path departure but changes its local grammatical relation.
The self as one's very identity becomes the bearer of the result.
Reorientation remains the opposed directional state, now explicitly source-enabled.

structural_cues: 34:8 has "في الضلال البعيد", 34:24 has "لعلى هدى أو في ضلال مبين", and 34:50 has "أضل على نفسي" opposed to "فبما يوحي".
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated spatial prepositions and their changes; I treat container, footing, burden, and means as functional spatial roles. These prepositions may alternatively be conventional idioms with less mechanical force.

changed_reading.before: Error and guidance are simply opposite states.
changed_reading.after: The surah relocates their mechanics: guidance is a footing reached through supplied indication, error is an enclosing distance, and its realized cost is laid upon the erring self.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible, measured itinerary is made available for secure travel; the travelers request that its stages be pushed farther apart, wrong themselves, and are scattered. This gives "ضللت على نفسي" an enacted route model: self-harm occurs by converting accessible orientation into remoteness until the traveling collective loses coherence.

activation_trace.role: Prominence and disclosure make the route's stations inspectable rather than hidden.
Deliberate measured arrangement supplies the route's usable spacing.
Going and flowing turn the arrangement into a traversable itinerary.
Actively causing distance is the requested modification that breaks accessibility.
Their own identities are named as the immediate objects of the resulting wrong.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the terminal loss of route and group coherence.
Loss of a thing or its place names the focus outcome of the remoteness sequence.

structural_cues: 34:18 moves through visible settlements with measured travel in safety; 34:19 requests greater distance, names self-wrong, and ends in complete scattering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prepared route, chosen remoteness, self-wrong, and dispersal; I infer a causal route-degradation sequence. A live alternative is that the distance request expresses ingratitude without defining straying itself.

changed_reading.before: To stray against oneself is to choose a wrong direction.
changed_reading.after: It can be the infrastructural act of making a usable route remote: the subject degrades its own access until both location and communal coherence are lost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context depicts following another, being diverted from guidance, and receiving coercive commands. Those are real social causes of error, yet guilt remains attached to agents. Thus "على نفسي" marks non-transferable loss and liability, not an assertion that no one can influence another.

activation_trace.role: Following behind another supplies a genuine external pathway into error.
Turning and diverting name the accused social interference with access.
Path indication is the object from which the vulnerable claim they were diverted.
Guilt and offense keep agency attached to those who answered the pressure.
Demand and compulsion supply a second concrete mechanism of social influence.
The self remains the terminal bearer even within a network of influence.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between the weak and arrogant, including obstruction, night-and-day plotting, and commands; neither side succeeds in transferring the final account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, diversion, commands, and retained guilt; I infer a distinction between causal influence and final liability. The alternative is to read "على نفسي" as both internally caused and internally borne, but the social scenes make that stronger exclusivity difficult.

changed_reading.before: My straying is solely self-caused and concerns no external agent.
changed_reading.after: Others can pressure, divert, and command, but the realized loss cannot be assigned away: "upon myself" fixes consequence without denying social causation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth and descendants are denied the power to transport their possessors into privileged proximity. The focus's "قريب" therefore first names the Lord's own availability as hearer and source, not a rank manufactured by assets or lineage; human standing is a separate responsive relation.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the rejected means of purchasing proximity.
Lineal offspring supply the rejected means of inheriting proximity.
Caused nearness names the transport that possessions and descendants cannot perform.
Proximity as standing or station identifies the status at issue in the denial.
Hearing makes the focus nearness immediately communicative.
The Lord's nearness is asserted directly, before any asset can mediate it.

structural_cues: 34:37 denies that wealth or children bring people near, then distinguishes belief and fitting action; 34:50 predicates hearing and nearness directly of the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two uses of proximity and a rejected material transport; I distinguish source-availability from acquired human station. A live alternative is that both passages use one status relation viewed from opposite sides.

changed_reading.before: "Near" is a general assurance of divine closeness.
changed_reading.after: It denies the need for a purchased or inherited access mechanism: the revealer-hearer is already near, while favored standing concerns how recipients answer that access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding instruction combines warning, deliberate standing, paired and solitary configurations, and repeated inward thought. Against that method, the focus conditional reads as disciplined self-testing: the speaker permits the hypothesis of his own error while locating positive orientation in revelation rather than claiming automatic personal certainty.

activation_trace.role: Fear-awakening reminder supplies the stakes that initiate examination.
Resolved rising to the task supplies deliberate readiness rather than passive opinion.
Joining one to one supplies a paired checking configuration.
The isolated individual supplies an independent checking configuration.
The heart's repeated movement through a matter supplies active reconsideration.
Intention and discernment within the self become the object of the diagnostic.
Hidden impartation supplies the external calibration that prevents self-testing from becoming self-authorizing.

structural_cues: 34:46 orders standing for God in pairs and singly and then thinking; 34:50 uses parallel first-person conditionals rather than an unqualified claim of personal correctness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an examination procedure and a conditional self-account; I infer that the latter models the posture requested by the former. The alternative is that 34:46 addresses opponents only and does not describe the speaker's stance.

changed_reading.before: The conditional is a rhetorical concession about possible error.
changed_reading.after: It also models an epistemic discipline: expose the self to examination, allow its failure to remain live, and credit successful orientation to received calibration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord casts stable truth, whereas opponents cast speech toward the unseen from a distant position and later cannot reach what they claim from afar. The focus sits between these motions and specifies the reliable channel: guidance is received through revelation from a near, hearing source, not projected into hidden reality from distance.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies forceful outward delivery, here carrying truth from the knowledgeable Lord.
Stable correspondence with reality qualifies the content of the divine casting.
Reaching by extension names the access that a distant position no longer permits.
Distance from nearness blocks belated access.
Throwing speech supplies the counter-motion of unsupported verbal projection.
What is screened from sight is the target about which the distant speech projects.
Remoteness diagnoses the projectors' lack of epistemic access.
Secretly delivered knowledge supplies reception rather than projection.
Hearing makes the reliable channel reciprocal and answerable.
Nearness is the decisive opposite of the distance from which unseen claims are hurled.

structural_cues: 34:48 has the Lord casting truth as knower of unseen things; 34:50 credits guidance to revelation and closes with hearing-nearness; 34:52-53 repeat failed reaching and casting from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored casting, hidden reality, failed reaching, and near/far poles; I infer an epistemic contrast between reception and projection. The alternative is that the repeated casting is rhetorical wordplay without a technical account of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Revelation is one true information source among false assertions.
changed_reading.after: The coda maps two opposed epistemic motions: truth arrives through a near receptive channel, while error throws speech at hidden reality from a location too distant to reach it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, there is no escape and seizure comes from a near place; the closing barrier then separates people from what they desire. "سميع قريب" therefore carries a juridical edge alongside reassurance: speech and deviation are already within hearing range and enforcement distance.

activation_trace.role: Failure to escape or remain unreachable removes any latency in consequence.
Seizure and capture turn proximity into operative jurisdiction.
The near place supplies the short range from which capture occurs.
An intervening barrier supplies the final irreversible separation.
Hearing places every voiced claim within cognizance before enforcement.
Nearness makes divine cognizance operational rather than merely affective.

structural_cues: 34:50 ends "Hearing, Near"; 34:51 immediately negates escape and describes seizure from a near place; 34:54 ends with an imposed barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, hearing, near seizure, and final separation; I infer that proximity compresses the interval between cognizance and consequence. The live alternative is that divine nearness in 34:50 is purely consolatory and 34:51 uses unrelated spatial language.

changed_reading.before: "Hearing, Near" comforts the speaker that revelation and prayer are attended.
changed_reading.after: It also warns that error cannot create jurisdictional distance: the One who hears is already close enough for consequence to arrive without escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The nourishment-and-growth image comes through the packet's secondary mapping of ر ب ب to ر ب و, so it is form-distant and must not replace the direct Lordship sense. It remains anchored to "ربي" and is reinforced by the primary repair-and-upbringing branch; downstream prose should label it a cultivation analogy, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possessive "ربي" names the source whose revelation produces the speaker's guidance.

activation_trace.role: Repair, upbringing, and stagewise completion supply the primary formative mechanism.
Nourishment and growth extend formative Lordship into an exploratory cultivation image.
A gentle gift makes guidance something bestowed for development rather than extracted by the self.
Divine inspiration supplies what is fed into that developmental process.
Lordship appears in the flourishing settlement scene and supports care that can be answered or refused.
Turning one's side away supplies refusal of the cultivating relation.
Replacement of one yield by another supplies the changed fruit of refusal.

changed_reading.before: The Lord transmits correct information that guides the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, revelation is also formative intake: the Lord cultivates orientation stage by stage, while turning away changes what the life under cultivation yields.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The water-seeking and waterskin branches of ق ر ب are concrete cross-domain images, not the ordinary predication of "قريب" here. They remain anchored to the exact focus root and become coherent with the surah's measured journeys and failed reaching; downstream prose should present this only as a logistics analogy for access to sustaining revelation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The closing "قريب" is the point at which the focus explicitly negates distance from the revealer.

activation_trace.role: Night travel toward a water source turns nearness into reachable supply.
The water container makes proximity portable as a held reserve.
Hidden delivery supplies the sustaining content carried through the access analogy.
Traversable movement through measured stages supplies the logistics frame.
Deliberately increasing distance makes the sustaining source harder to reach.
Failed extension toward a distant object supplies the terminal access failure.

changed_reading.before: The Lord is spatially or relationally close.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, revelation is a sustaining source already within reach; straying consists in redesigning the journey until the source can no longer be reached or carried.

strongest_changes: The repeated "قل" sequence turns the focus's first-person humility into commissioned revelation in action.
The surah's route grammar moves from visible measured access to chosen remoteness and self-fragmentation, giving "على نفسي" an infrastructural mechanism.
Social following, obstruction, and commands revise self-liability into non-transferable consequence without denying external influence.
The final casting and distance pattern opposes near reception of hidden knowledge to unsupported projection at the unseen, while near seizure adds an immediate jurisdictional edge.
summary.what_was_special: The focus condenses the surah's speech, route, and distance systems into one asymmetric conditional: the self owns path-loss, but not the production of guidance; hidden content becomes voiced through a nearby hearing relation.
remaining_uncertainties: The force assigned to "على", "في", and "بما" may exceed ordinary idiomatic syntax even though the repeated spatial pattern supports it.
"سميع قريب" can sustain both consolatory access and immediate jurisdiction; the context does not require choosing one.
The cultivation and water-access readings depend on form-distant or cross-domain branch images and should remain explicitly exploratory.
